richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Deoghar

c: Deoghar in Jharkhand is one of India's great pilgrimage towns, home to the Baidyanath temple, and during the Shravan month it fills with kanwariyas who walk here carrying Ganga water. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Deoghar to hotels, dharamshalas, schools, colleges, municipal parks and residential colonies. The machines are built at our Vasai factory, about 1,530 km away, and delivered by road.

A town that sees very large crowds in some months and quieter streets in others needs public equipment that can take sudden heavy use. Fixed, grouted machines with no loose parts are the safest choice for parks near busy routes. Hotels and dharamshalas have a different need. A small fitness corner on the terrace or in a courtyard gives guests and staff a place to stretch. The plateau climate brings hot summers, a good monsoon and cool winters.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Can a hotel or dharamshala in Deoghar have an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. A small corner of two or three machines on a courtyard or terrace works well. We check the surface and suggest grouted or self-standing installation.

items.q: Will the machines cope with large crowds during Shravan?
items.a: Grouted machines with galvanised frames are built for public use. Check bolts and moving parts before and after the busy month, and report any damage to our after-sales team.
Yes. We send the machines by road from Vasai, and our team or a dealer covering eastern India installs them. Plan the work outside the Shravan month, when roads in the town are crowded.
